title: Generate documentation using OpenAPI
description:
Enterprise only. Generates OpenAPI documentation automatically through `krakend openapi export` command.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/developer/openapi/

description.title: API Description
description.description:
An introductory, optionally verbose, explanation supporting [CommonMark](http://commonmark.org/help/) syntax. If you'd like to load an **external markdown file**, you can use flexible configuration, for instance `"description": {{include "openapi/intro.md" | toJson }}`

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/developer/openapi/

base_path.title: Base path
base_path.description:
A starting path that is appended to any endpoint.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/developer/openapi/

components_schemas.title: Component Schemas
components_schemas.description: The JSON Schemas you can reuse inside endpoint definitions using `ref`. You can either pass the JSON Schema object, or a bas64 string.

.*.title: JSON Schema
.*.description: JSON Schema in base64 or as an object

components_parameters.title: Component Parameters
components_parameters.description: The parameter definitions you can reuse inside endpoint definitions using `ref`. You can either pass the parameter object, or a base64 string.

.*.title: Parameter
.*.description: OpenAPI parameter definition in base64 or as an object

contact_email.title: Contact email
contact_email.description:
Email where users of your API can write to.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/developer/openapi/

contact_url.title: Contact URL
contact_url.description:
Contact URL that users of your API can read.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/developer/openapi/

cookie_name.title: Cookie name
cookie_name.description: When generating an OpenAPI spec, the name of the cookie used under components securitySchemes.

custom_security_schemes.title: Custom security schemes
custom_security_schemes.description:
Allows you to add custom security schemes under `components/securitySchemes` in the generated OpenAPI spec. This is useful when you want to define your own security schemes, different from the built-in ones (e.g., `jwt`, `apikey`, `cookie`, etc.). When the property is in the service level you must declare the schema (e.g., `"OAuth2Security":{...}`), and when it is in the endpoint you should only write the object name with not properties inside, e.g, `{"OAuth2Security":{}`.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/developer/openapi/

^.*$.title: Security Scheme
^.*$.description: A valid OpenAPI Security Scheme object.

host.title: Host
host.description:
The hostname where you will publish your API.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/developer/openapi/

jwt_key.title: JWT key
jwt_key.description: When generating an OpenAPI spec, the name of the JWT key used under components securitySchemes.

license_name.title: License name
license_name.description:
The license name (e.g.: Apache License)

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/developer/openapi/

license_url.title: License URL
license_url.description:
The URL where the license is hosted

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/developer/openapi/

servers.title: Servers
servers.description:
The list of servers where the API is hosted. The server URL can be a relative path, e.g., `/v1` or an absolute path. The URL might contain `{variables}`, although these are only recognized by OpenAPI and to KrakenD they are just literal strings because it does not use them.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/developer/openapi/

description.title: Description
description.description: A short description of the server URL.

url.title: URL
url.description: The URL of the server. This URL will be used as the base path for all endpoints.

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: A [Server Variable Object](https://github.com/OAI/OpenAPI-Specification/blob/main/versions/3.0.3.md#server-variable-object) according to the OpenAPI specification. The variable name is the key and the value is the default value for that variable.

tag_definition.title: Tag definition
tag_definition.description:
Sets a detailed description for the tags classifiying endpoints when generating the OpenAPI spec.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/developer/openapi/

description.title: Tag Description
description.description: Describe what this tag is grouping

name.title: Tag name
name.description: The name of the tag. You will use this name in each endpoint.

terms_of_service.title: Terms of Service
terms_of_service.description:
The URL to the terms of service for using this API.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/developer/openapi/

version.title: Version
version.description:
The version numbering you want to apply to this release of API., e.g.: `1.0`.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/developer/openapi/
